projectDescription: An independent help guide that walks users through signing in to streaming services on their TV using a device activation code.
keyFeatures: Step-by-step TV activation code sign-in walkthrough
Device-specific guides for Smart TVs, streaming sticks, and game consoles
Common error troubleshooting (expired codes, connectivity issues)
FAQ covering account requirements and the activation process
Independent, unaffiliated resource covering general streaming sign-in flows
